structured.answer: The second option. It says in Hebrew what each fund holds ("מאה עשרים וחמש החברות... בבורסה בתל אביב"), while the first has only letters and numbers. I still wouldn't put money into any of these; I'd ask my son or the bank.

To me מדד is the price index on the news, so I didn't understand what this column was until the second option explained it.
